title: Indie Rock Concert Poster
prompt_text: Create an indie rock concert poster, 24×36 inch portrait. Headline: "[BAND NAME]" in bold all-caps display sans-serif, top half. Subheading: "WORLD TOUR 2026" in subtle outline serif. Centerpiece: silhouette of a guitarist in dramatic backlight, surrounded by abstract sound-wave patterns. Background: deep charcoal with neon magenta and cyan accents, screen-print halftone texture. Bottom: tour dates + venue + ticket info in small monospace. Aesthetic: gig poster, screen print feel.

title: Festival Lineup Poster
prompt_text: Create a music festival lineup poster, 24×36 inch portrait. Top: festival name "[FESTIVAL NAME]" in psychedelic 1970s display font with rainbow gradient. Body: tiered band lineup with main headliners largest, secondary acts smaller. Background: warm sunset gradient with abstract floral and geometric pattern motifs. Footer: dates, venue, ticket call-to-action. Aesthetic: vintage festival poster meets modern minimal layout.

title: 1970s Diner Vintage Poster
prompt_text: Create a 1970s diner-style vintage poster, 18×24 inch portrait. Centerpiece: stylized illustration of a classic milkshake or burger with retro halo glow. Title "[DINER NAME]" in chunky 1970s display font, warm orange and cream colors. Background: faded yellow-orange gradient with halftone texture and slight aging. Subtle starburst accents. Footer: "OPEN DAILY" tagline in retro script. Aesthetic: aged paper feel, period-correct color palette.

title: 1950s Sci-Fi Movie Poster
prompt_text: Create a 1950s pulp sci-fi B-movie poster, 24×36 inch portrait. Centerpiece: dramatic illustration of a giant retro robot looming over fleeing crowd. Title "[MOVIE TITLE]" in lurid red Saturday-matinee display font. Subtitle: "IT CAME FROM BEYOND!" in yellow exclamation font. Color palette: bold red, yellow, deep navy, period-correct halftone print texture. Aged paper background with slight foxing. Aesthetic: Forrest J. Ackerman / Frank R. Paul nostalgia.

title: Soviet-Style Propaganda Poster
prompt_text: Create a Soviet-style propaganda poster, 24×36 inch portrait. Centerpiece: bold heroic worker silhouette raised fist, looking forward toward an imagined future. Background: deep red with sunburst rays radiating from center. Title: "[SLOGAN]" in bold sans-serif Cyrillic-influenced display font, all caps, white. Subtitle: small revolutionary tagline. Aesthetic: 1920s Constructivist with strong diagonal composition, limited two-color palette (red and cream).

title: Bauhaus Geometric Propaganda Poster
prompt_text: Create a Bauhaus-inspired propaganda poster, 24×36 portrait. Composition: bold geometric shapes (red triangle, blue circle, yellow square) arranged dynamically. Title: "[STATEMENT]" in bold geometric sans-serif (Futura-style), strong horizontal placement. Limited primary-colors palette: red, yellow, blue, black on cream paper. Subtle paper grain. Aesthetic: 1923 Weimar design school, modernist clean lines, strong typographic statement.
